exposure: Body mass index (BMI) categorized into three groups: <25, 25-29.9, and ≥30 kg/m²
outcome: Effective dose (ED50) and ED95 of spinal ropivacaine
cohort: 405 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery
finding: Spinal ropivacaine dose requirements for effective anesthesia were similar across BMI groups, but obese patients experienced a higher incidence and severity of hypotension with higher ropivacaine doses.
